failure_code.description: Provider-defined lower snake-case ASCII failure identifier.

failure_message.description: Non-empty Unicode scalar text preserved verbatim. Whitespace, newlines, format characters, and controls other than U+0000 are allowed. The API returns this provider-controlled diagnostic verbatim to authorized readers of the Job's execution history, who must treat it as untrusted text. It must not contain secrets, raw inputs or results, stack traces, or sensitive provider internals.
